description: The deriver's findings that the contract does not hold. CAT adds these properties to the proposal schema for the deriver's output.

derived_sources.description: Every prompt file that loads for this prompt system although no harness event reports it, with the documented rule that loads it. Empty if none.

profile_restriction.description: The trial profiles that the user's feedback restricts every category to, as patterns over the harness's profile inventory. An empty model or effort matches every value. Empty unless the user asked for a restriction.

conflicts.description: Every set of requirements that no reply can satisfy together. Empty if none.

evidence.description: The file and the text that show the conflict.

resolutions.description: Changes to the requirements that resolve the conflict.

recommended.description: The 1-based position of the recommended resolution in resolutions.

reason.description: Why this resolution best preserves the prompt intent.

scope_conditions.description: Every condition that makes certification unavailable. Empty if none.

evidence.description: The file and the text that show the condition.
